name: 4-MeO-DET
summary: 4-MeO-DET, also known as 4-methoxy-N,N-diethyltryptamine, is a chemical compound of the tryptamine and 4-methoxytryptamine families related to psilocin (4-HO-DMT). It is the 4-methoxy derivative of diethyltryptamine (DET), the O-methyl ether 4-HO-DET (ethocin), and a positional isomer of 5-MeO-DET.

fact.en: It is a positional isomer of 5-MeO-DET: both have exactly the same atoms, and only the position of the methoxy group on the ring differs.
fact.zh: 它是5-MeO-DET的位置異構物：兩者的原子完全相同，只有甲氧基在環上的位置不同。
fact.zhHans: 它是5-MeO-DET的位置异构物：两者的原子完全相同，只有甲氧基在环上的位置不同。
